scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @inazuma/shared run build && concurrently "pnpm --filter @inazuma/shared run dev" "pnpm --filter backend run start:dev" "pnpm --filter frontend run dev" "pnpm --filter match-referee run dev"
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @inazuma/shared run test && pnpm --filter backend run test && pnpm --filter match-referee run test
scripts.build:backend: pnpm --filter @inazuma/shared run build && pnpm --filter backend exec prisma generate && pnpm --filter backend run build
scripts.build:frontend: pnpm --filter @inazuma/shared run build && pnpm --filter frontend run build
scripts.build:match-referee: pnpm --filter @inazuma/shared run build && pnpm --filter match-referee run build
